registry.name: Control — random side, every game
registry.role: CONTROL. Never eligible for a reward; its only job is to be the floor.
registry.rule: For every game on the slate, take a side by a coin flip fixed in advance by the game_id hash. Stake 1 unit at -110.

registration.note: control, not a hypothesis; no result may be used to tune it

registry.expected_from_control: break-even hit rate 52.38%; any edge over this must survive G4 and G5 before it is called skill
registry.what_would_change_our_mind: Nothing. A control that starts beating the field means the scoring, not the control, is broken.
registry.multiplicity_detail: not tested: n=0 forecasts, p=1.0 after BH across 11 registered hypotheses

registry.name: Control — favourites only

registry.what_would_change_our_mind: Sustained positive CLV on a pre-registered, frozen version. A season of profit alone would not.
registry.multiplicity_detail: not tested: n=0 forecasts, p=1.0 after BH across 11 registered hypotheses

registry.name: Scoring-margin baseline (PF-PA per game)
registry.role: CANDIDATE. Deliberately the simplest strength model: if a complex model cannot beat this, it is not earning its complexity.
registry.rule: Rating = (PF - PA) / games played, from the official league table, computed only from games completed before the kickoff being forecast. Home-side rating difference plus a fixed home-field constant of 3.0 points is the fair spread.
registry.inputs: official PF, PA, W, L, T per club (S03 at the time of the bet)

registration.note: rule text above is the freeze candidate; it is not yet committed as a hash-pinned registration

registry.power_note: needs 1,540 scored forecasts to detect a 55% vs 52.4% edge at 80% power
registry.what_would_change_our_mind: BSS lower bound below zero for two consecutive registered windows; or the Elo model beating it on the same window by more than the interval width.
registry.multiplicity_detail: not tested: n=0 forecasts, p=1.0 after BH across 11 registered hypotheses

registry.name: Causal Elo (fl1-elo-v1), frozen
registry.role: CANDIDATE. Exists in this repository as a model version string; it has never been scored against a benchmark.
registry.rule: Elo with K=20, home-field 48 rating points, inter-season regression x0.75 toward 1505, margin-of-victory multiplier. Spread = 10.8*log10(p/(1-p)). Version string recorded per row in data/fair_lines.csv.
registry.inputs: game results before kickoff only (causal), from the official results feed

registration.note: the version string is recorded per row, but no commit hash freezes the code that produced it

registry.what_would_change_our_mind: It is beaten on the same window by the PF-PA baseline; the spread constant (10.8) is not validated against a price, only against itself.
registry.multiplicity_detail: not tested: n=0 forecasts, p=1.0 after BH across 11 registered hypotheses
registry.note: this entry's own recorded probabilities were scored ex post, not pre-registered: the number shows the model exists and can be evaluated, and it does NOT count as a prospective record

registry.name: Availability-surprise overlay
registry.role: CANDIDATE. The brief's central modelling idea: an injury signal must be a surprise, never a level.
registry.rule: For each club, compute an availability index as the sum over unavailable starters of a *string gap*, and forecast the change in the index between the last pre-kickoff snapshot and the season average. A club whose index is worse than its own trailing distribution is a candidate; the size of the deviation, not the count of injured players, is the input.
registry.inputs: official injury report snapshots (S89 for the Week 10 capture), club depth charts with their source ids, and the published designation

registration.note: blocked: needs at least two dated pre-kickoff snapshots per game, which the repository does not yet hold

registry.blocking_gate: D5-G2 and D5-G3: no snapshot pair exists for any game, so no forecast can be scored
registry.what_would_change_our_mind: An ablation that shows the personnel features add nothing to BSS on chronological holdouts (that ablation is registered as D5S11).
registry.multiplicity_detail: not tested: n=0 forecasts, p=1.0 after BH across 11 registered hypotheses

registry.name: REJECTED — rank by season-long ROI
registry.role: REJECTED by the brief itself. Kept in the register so the rejection is visible, not silent.
registry.rule: Rank strategies by realised return over the season.

registration.note: rejected before evaluation, which is the correct time to reject a rule

registry.rejection_reason: Season-long ROI is dominated by variance at this sample size: one 5-unit dog at +400 moves a whole-season number more than a real 2% edge over 100 bets. It is a staking statistic masquerading as a skill statistic.
registry.what_would_change_our_mind: Nothing on this timeline. It could be revisited only as a secondary display once G4 is passed by a pre-registered rule.

registry.name: Ablation — personnel features on vs off
registry.role: CANDIDATE (method). The brief asks for ablations instead of fixed point penalties; this is that ablation, registered as its own entry.
registry.rule: Run the identical singles model twice, once with verified availability features and once without, on the same chronological holdouts. Report the BSS difference with its game-cluster interval. A fixed 'starter out = -2 points' penalty is forbidden.
registry.what_would_change_our_mind: A difference interval that spans zero: then the personnel features are not earning their data cost, and should be dropped rather than tuned.
